clips.title: The story
paras: A dark rite waits at Gunther's Retreat on Brightwater Lake in Tirisfal Glades. Set a mystic candle on an old, blood-soaked table to summon Lillith Nefara, a Scourge agent, and prove to Gunther Arcanus that you oppose the Lich King.

On Gunther's Retreat, an island in Brightwater Lake, a battered dinner table lies stained with blood. The table is no ordinary abandoned piece of furniture. It is the focus of a dark conjuration, a rough slab where dried gore marks the place death and dark magic gather.

clips.title: Completion
